headline: T-Mobile’s $0-down financing plan bundles taxes and fees
summary: T-Mobile introduces EIP Flex 36, a new 0% APR financing plan. Customers can pay for devices, taxes, and fees over 36 months. The plan requires no upfront payment for a limited time.

headline: Skylight’s smart calendars are up to $90 off during its back-to-school sale
summary: Skylight smart calendars are on sale for back-to-school, saving up to $90. These shared calendars help families organize hectic schedules. The sale runs from August 2nd through August 9th.

headline: Samsung’s HDR10 Plus Advanced is launching this month on Prime Video
summary: Samsung's HDR10 Plus Advanced will launch globally on Amazon Prime Video this month. The new HDR standard offers more precise, optimized viewing. Samsung's 2026 TV lineup will be the first to support this feature.

headline: Texas says data centers must pass an audit before connecting to the grid
summary: Texas Governor Greg Abbott has mandated new audits for data centers. The audits will verify proposals before connecting to the state energy grid. This measure could potentially slow down approvals for new facilities.

headline: The FlashForge AD5X Multi-Color 3D Printer Drops to Just $210 Shipped at AliExpress
summary: The FlashForge AD5X Multi-Color 3D Printer is on sale for $210 at AliExpress. This represents a significant discount compared to its $350 Amazon price. The deal includes free shipping.

headline: FC 27’s The Grounds Looks Like PlayStation Home For Football Fans
summary: FC 27 introduces 'The Grounds,' a major new open-world mode. Developers call it 'one of our biggest reinventions in recent history.' The mode is likened to PlayStation Home for football enthusiasts.

headline: Magic's Next Secret Lair Commander Deck Is The Long-Rumored Hatsune Miku Collab
summary: Wizards of the Coast announces a new MTG Secret Lair Commander Deck: Hatsune Miku. The deck features 100 cards with unique artwork. It will be available for preorder during a limited 24-hour window.

headline: 'It Would Be a Real Shame for That Culture to Disappear': Final Fantasy 7 Revelation Director Says Physical Game Releases Must Continue
summary: Final Fantasy 7 Remake director Naoki Hamaguchi advocates for continued physical game releases. He believes ending physical games risks losing part of gaming culture. Comments follow Sony's decision to discontinue PlayStation 5 discs.

headline: Video shows Russian drone chasing Ukrainian street vendor in 'human safari' attack
summary: A video shows a Russian drone hounding a Ukrainian civilian. Ukraine condemned the incident as a 'human safari' attack and a war crime. The remotely-controlled drone pursued a terrified street vendor.

headline: More than 170 migrants rescued after boat catches fire in Channel
summary: Over 170 migrants were rescued after their boat caught fire in the Channel. They were attempting to cross to the UK. The government states all rescued migrants will be returned to France.

headline: Afghan boxer arrested in Greece over discovery of Scottish woman's body in suitcase
summary: Afghan boxer Sharif Ahmadzai has been arrested in Greece. The arrest is linked to the discovery of a Scottish woman's body in a suitcase. He is scheduled to appear in court in Athens.

headline: Oil prices fall on hopes Strait of Hormuz could reopen
summary: Oil prices are falling due to optimism about the Strait of Hormuz reopening. US officials Marco Rubio and Scott Bessent announced progress in talks. Resuming shipments through the strait is expected.
